activation: explicit selection by the consuming project only
composition: one selected profile per investigation; distinct subinvestigations may use different profiles with explicit handoffs
external_execution: optional existing authorised tools only; no automatic install, network call or job
pack_root_rules: relative paths resolve inside the selected pack root
reject absolute paths, traversal and external symlinks
do not include private project evidence
purpose: Assess open-source adoption evidence using revision, licence, code, package, maintenance and actually executed validation as distinct evidence.

method_sources.scope: Method principles and limits; no automatic external acquisition.

source ecology.rationale: Use repository files, commits, release and issue records when relevant; distinguish maintainer statements from code and execution evidence.

search strategy.rationale: Resolve immutable revisions and source paths first; bound any history/issues sample and never imply exhaustive maintenance review.

inclusion / exclusion rules.rationale: Choose projects against the stated need and licences; popularity is a discovery signal, not suitability or exclusion evidence.

source appraisal.rationale: Assess ownership, actual maintenance evidence, licence scope and test relevance separately; a green check does not cover all runtime paths.

research methods.rationale: Compare README, package and deployment facts at the same revision; classify static observations versus executed smoke/failure tests.

synthesis structure.rationale: Return a revision-bound suitability assessment with environment requirements, evidence kinds, missing tests and bounded adoption conditions.

quality criteria.rationale: Check code-to-claim traceability, maintenance inference, dependency boundaries and truthful installation/failure status.

reporting conventions.rationale: Cite file/ref/line or immutable item; label documented, inspected, executed and unknown rather than promoting stars or badges to assurance.

effects.change: Set task-fit criteria, pinned revision, allowed repository evidence and execution authority.
effects.observable: Static-only work cannot acquire install/run authority.

effects.change: Inspect native repository evidence and relevant history/issue samples at declared bounds.
effects.observable: Collection completeness and sampling limits remain explicit.

effects.change: Capture source path/ref/locator and evidence kind, including exact setup and licence scope.
effects.observable: README, package declarations and observed execution remain distinct.

effects.change: Reconcile configuration differences and bind code risks to specific missing tests.
effects.observable: A suspicious branch is recorded as a static finding, not a measured failure rate.

effects.change: Present evidence-qualified reuse conditions rather than a universal repository ranking.
effects.observable: Transitive rights, environment and runtime gaps remain visible.

effects.change: Compare changed revision/files and only reopen affected claims and validations.
effects.observable: A documentation change does not erase unrelated source checks.

effects.change: Check revision identity, licence scope, maintenance/sample inference and static-versus-executed wording.
effects.observable: An unexecuted installation cannot pass as operational readiness.

showcase.expected_change: Cross-file environment reconciliation and evidence-to-test conditions, retaining all known baseline cautions.

evaluation.required: Core invariants and all applicable specialist criteria; actual bounded core/pack pair and negative behaviour checks.
